_about: Public-domain John Shower, English Presbyterian minister in London, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and discourses from 1681 to 1712, among them An Exhortation to Youth, Serious Reflections on Time and Eternity, The Mourner's Companion, Sacramental Discourses, Family Religion, Of the Day of Grace, Winter Meditations, Of Long Life and Old Age, God's Thoughts and Ways, Heaven and Hell, and The Character and Trial of a Real Christian. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 134 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
